scope: Independent D57 package sub-row; exact owner selection only.

source.selection_rule: owner exactly Agent timeline occurrence/media fixture seam OR Agent timeline authenticated materialization fixture

control_basis.plan: PLAN.md §3 R1/R2/G2 and promised v2 editing end-state

core_classifier.scope_receipt: all selected nodes are non-core under other-noncore-171

definitions.non-core: Outside that D54 end-state model; fixture/materialization seams are conservatively non-core per the complete classifier.
definitions.env: Exact D52 setup/profile error membership only.
definitions.pre-existing: Requires exact same-selector FAIL on upstream 25359ed68.
definitions.dead-scope: Requires retired/dormant caller proof plus exclusive-test proof.
definitions.deferred: Only the exact approved D23 relational child-word timing mapping.
definitions.REGRESSION: Exact selector PASS on upstream 25359ed68 and FAIL on ours.
definitions.UNPROVEN: Required upstream comparison or other category proof is missing; no unknown is converted into qualified credit.

smallest_finite_request.selectors: the exact 66 node IDs listed in records
smallest_finite_request.observations: one ordinary baseline result per exact selector with durable identity; compare to retained full9758 ours result
smallest_finite_request.artifacts: baseline source/tree identity, exact command, durable result summary/JUnit or equivalent, selector mapping
smallest_finite_request.classification_rule: upstream PASS + ours FAIL => REGRESSION; upstream FAIL => pre-existing; otherwise UNPROVEN

records.production_caller: Not established by retained evidence; no caller invented

records.missing_fact: Current production caller, exact test input, and missing cause are not established by retained evidence
records.current_repair_scope: ours-live node repair/qualification only; no broad deletion/cross-repo inference
